recommendation: Keep the source fix. It restores consistency between the terminology narrative, the Additional Binding Purpose CodeSystem, and the original FHIR-26028/FHIR-22794 wording without reviving the removed standalone maxValueSet section or changing the later deprecation policy.
issue_request: FHIR-26028 was a Published Vocab change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking the core terminology page to clarify that rendered binding language such as "but limited to" represents a maximum value set declared with the maxValueSet extension.
initial_application: Git commit 633035c38a initially applied the issue by moving Binding Strengths under Controlling the use of Coded Values and adding a Max Value Set subsection that described maxValueSet for extensible or preferred bindings. FHIR-22794 later refined that section in ab0ada5222. Subsequent ElementDefinition and additional-binding refactors moved the explanation into the additional binding purpose table.
additional_context: The originating Zulip discussion and 2020 Vocab WGM minutes show that the confusing example was a preferred binding limited by a maximum value set. Later FHIR-46350, FHIR-43156, and FHIR-46445 deprecated maximum/maxValueSet in favor of required/additionalBinding semantics, but the current Additional Binding Purpose CodeSystem still defines maximum for extensible or preferred bindings. A 2025 terminology-page consolidation left the narrative table saying only extensible, losing the preferred-binding half of the original clarification.
reconciliation: Updated source/terminologies.html so the maximum additional-binding table row again says the main binding can have strength extensible or preferred, while preserving the current R5+ note that maximum replaces the deprecated maxValueSet extension and is equivalent to required.
source_changes: source/terminologies.html: changed the maximum additional-binding purpose description from extensible-only to extensible-or-preferred and adjusted the surrounding wording from codes used to extend the value set to codes used beyond the value set.

related_jiras.note: Added the later Maximum Value Set terminology-page section that refined the original FHIR-26028 maxValueSet clarification.
Clarified that maxValueSet behaves like a required binding and does not prohibit other Codings when the required binding is satisfied.
Deprecated maximum as an additional-binding purpose equivalent to required and moved guidance into consolidated terminology/additional-binding text.
FHIR Extension Pack decision to deprecate min/max value set binding extensions in favor of AdditionalBinding.
Vocab decision to deprecate elementdefinition-minValueSet and elementdefinition-maxValueSet in the Extension Pack.
